card.name: Linking words in blood-pressure monitoring text
card.fires_on: Small punctuation and linking words (closing parenthesis, or, and/or, in, e.g.,) that sit right before a list of hemodynamic measurements such as blood pressure, cardiac output or pulmonary wedge pressure, in IV cardiovascular drug labels.

modes.label: Punctuation before monitoring methods
modes.description: A closing parenthesis, comma or 'or' just before the named device or measure to be monitored.
modes.example: using either a continually reinflated sphygmomanometer or (preferably<<)>> an intra-arterial pressure sensor.

modes.label: Linking word before hemodynamic terms
modes.description: 'and/or' or 'in' just before cardiac output or wedge pressure terms.
modes.example: central venous pressure, and<</or>> pulmonary capillary wedge pressure.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted 'derived' tokens; it seems to hold back a next word in hemodynamic lists.
card.plain: It marks small joining words and brackets right before blood pressure and cardiac output measurements in infusion drug labels.
